name: Musuko no Yome wa Ore no Mono -Joi to Nurse ni Shikomu Tane-
original_name: 息子の嫁は親父の女 -女医とナースに仕込む胤-
source:
I'm the director of a hospital and now thinking about a successor. Setsuka, one of my daughters, is one of the candidates, but her husband hates me. How about Mayuki, Setsuka's younger sister? There is, however, a man who's been persistently approaching her. Who the hell is he!? I don't want a man whom I don't allow to be my successor! What should I do...? Oh, it's easy. I should make them pregnant. That sounds great.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090208170043/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012045]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
我是这家医院的院长，如今正在考虑接班人的人选。我的一个女儿最上雪花也是候选者之一，可她的丈夫讨厌我。那么，雪花的妹妹真幸怎么样？偏偏又有个男人对她纠缠不休。那家伙究竟是什么人！？我绝不允许一个没得到我认可的男人成为继承人！

该怎么办呢……？哦，很简单。只要让她们怀上我的孩子就行了。真是个好主意。

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090208170043/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012045]ErogeShop[/url]]
